dedupe_keys.name: complexnettsp power grid topologies from openstreetmap

description: This data set gives power grid topologies extracted from OpenStreetMap for countries and continents, as graphs for complex network analysis. It was released on GitHub and archived on Zenodo in January 2017 (version 1.0.0) by Gensollen of the ComplexNetTSP group. For each country and continent there are node and edge tables, graphs in GraphML format and images in which stations, generators and joints are coloured differently; high-voltage files are given separately. The README warns that OpenStreetMap is crowdsourced, so the topologies are approximations that may be incomplete or wrong, and points to the SciGRID project for the gap between mapped lines and an electrical model. Coverage is the countries and continents in the repository. Files are CSV, GraphML and PNG, downloadable from GitHub or Zenodo at no cost; no licence file is given, although the underlying data come from OpenStreetMap. Caveats: the data date from 2017 and carry no electrical parameters. Simulation uses are topological robustness, cascading failure and network science studies of power grids. Related records: data-gridkit-power-grid-extracts is a comparable OpenStreetMap grid extraction with more attributes.
